Niall Bhattacharya

Postdoctoral Research Fellow · Wellcome Centre for Human Neuroimaging, University College London

  • n.bhattacharya@ucl.ac.uk
  • iD 0000-0002-1948-3367
  • Google Scholar
  • GitHub

I am a cognitive neuroscientist studying how the brain sustains attention over time and why this capacity breaks down in early-stage neurodegenerative disease. My work combines 7T fMRI, drift-diffusion modelling, and ambulatory behavioural assays in patients with Parkinson’s disease and Lewy body dementia. I am broadly interested in pulvino-cortical circuits, individual variability in attentional tone, and what longitudinal data can tell us about prodromal cognitive decline.
